d:
Bollywood actor Saif Ali Khan has reportedly received a death threat linked to Kareena Kapoor. According to Mumbai Police sources, a viral audio clip features a caller identifying himself as Zeeshan Akhtar a wanted accused in the October 2024 Baba Siddique murder case claiming affiliation with the Rohit Godara gang and warning Saif of a similar fate while referencing last year's knife attack on him.
